response.reason: The partner index for the real-FFT reconstruction is wrong: after the DIF stages position p holds Z[rev(p)], so Z[M-k] resides at rev((M-k) mod M), but the code computes partner = (-rev(k)) mod M. These differ in general (e.g. M=4, k=1: needed position 3, code uses 2), so br/bi fetch Z[M-1-k]-like wrong values; an explicit N=8 hand simulation (x=[1,0,0,1,0,0,0,0]) yields X[1].real=2 instead of the exact 0.2929, far outside tolerance.
